record.paper_title: Open Problems on Open Algebraic Varieties (Montreal 1994 Problems)
record.original_question: For contractible, acyclic, or Q-acyclic surfaces of log-general type, consider minimal smooth SNC completions and the associated Eisenbud-Neumann diagrams of their boundaries. Is the set of all such diagrams finite?

evidence.quote: 1.6. QUESTION. Is the number of all Eisenbud–Neumann diagrams ˘ΓD of the boundaries D of the minimal smooth SNC–completions of the contractible ( resp. acyclic, resp. Q-acyclic) surfaces of log–general type ﬁnite ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and setup. Let $X$ be a smooth complex algebraic surface that is contractible (resp. acyclic, i.e. has the integral homology of a point; resp. $\mathbb{Q}$-acyclic, i.e. $H_i(X;\mathbb{Q})=0$ for $i>0$). A smooth SNC-completion of $X$ is a pair $(V,D)$ where $V$ is a smooth projective surface, $D\subset V$ is a reduced simple normal crossing divisor (each component is smooth and components meet transversally with at most double points), and $V\setminus D\cong X$. Such a completion $(V,D)$ is called minimal if no irreducible component of $D$ is a $(-1)$-curve that can be smoothly contracted while preserving the SNC property.

Assume that $X$ is of log-general type, i.e. the logarithmic Kodaira dimension $\bar\kappa(X)$ equals $2$.

To the boundary divisor $D$ of a minimal smooth SNC-completion one associates its Eisenbud–Neumann splice diagram $\check{\Gamma}_D$: the weighted graph encoding the dual graph of $D$ together with the genera of components and self-intersection numbers (equivalently, the splice diagram describing the link of the singularity at infinity of $X$ as a graph manifold).

Question. Is the set
$$\{\,\check{\Gamma}_D : (V,D) \text{ is a minimal smooth SNC-completion of some smooth complex surface } X\}$$
finite, when $X$ ranges over all smooth contractible (resp. acyclic, resp. $\mathbb{Q}$-acyclic) complex algebraic surfaces of log-general type?
artifact.status_search_result: A definitive resolution of the finiteness question for Eisenbud–Neumann boundary diagrams of minimal SNC-completions of contractible/acyclic/Q-acyclic surfaces of log-general type was not found. Related progress exists (work of Palka and others on Q-acyclic surfaces and on effective versions of Zaidenberg-type finiteness conjectures for boundary diagrams of cuspidal curves), but no source clearly settles this exact problem in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Karol Palka — research profile
status_evidence.snippet: Work on Q-acyclic surfaces, their boundaries, and effective Zaidenberg-type finiteness statements via the Minimal Model Program.
status_evidence.claim: Partial finiteness-type results in nearby settings exist, but no clear resolution of the stated question is identified.

status_evidence.title: Q-acyclic surfaces and their deformations
status_evidence.snippet: Studies SNC-pairs (V,D) with V\D being Q-acyclic and analyses their boundary structure.
status_evidence.claim: Provides structural results on boundaries of Q-acyclic surfaces but does not establish global finiteness of all Eisenbud–Neumann diagrams.
